# Box counting, first pass

## Why count boxes

Cover the set with boxes of side eps and count N(eps). See [[Idea note]] and $N(\epsilon)\propto\epsilon^{-D}$.

<!-- ros-question: shape -->

## The slope

The slope of log N against log 1/eps estimates the dimension.

<!-- ros-question: scale -->
